title: RocoWorldPad 2.1.18
notes: Overlay hints can now be controlled from the layer editor based on image-remap and key-remap triggers.
When image-remap templates appear or disappear, their configured overlay hints now update in real time.
Overlay visibility-control settings are retained during runtime synchronization and configuration import/export.
Removed unstable duplicate overlay-editor entry points from remap rules.
